description: Autonomous Mode - GitHub-driven development for vsphere-ai-dashboard

tasks.name: GitHub Issue Worker
tasks.description: Fetch open issues from GitHub, pick one, implement it, create a PR
tasks.prompt:
You are an autonomous developer for the vsphere-ai-dashboard project.

1. Run: gh issue list --repo $GITHUB_REPO --state open --limit 10 --json number,title,body,labels
2. Pick the most actionable issue (prefer bugs over features, prefer issues labeled 'autonomous' or 'good-first-issue' if any exist).
3. Read the issue details: gh issue view <number> --repo $GITHUB_REPO
4. Analyze the codebase to understand the relevant code.
5. Create a feature branch: git checkout -b autonomous/issue-<number>
6. Implement the fix or feature with tests where applicable.
7. Commit your changes with clear messages referencing the issue (e.g., 'fix #28: ...' or 'feat #30: ...').
8. Push the branch: git push origin autonomous/issue-<number>
9. Create a PR: gh pr create --repo $GITHUB_REPO --title '<type>: <summary> (closes #<number>)' --body '<description of changes>'
10. If you cannot complete the issue, add a comment explaining what you found: gh issue comment <number> --repo $GITHUB_REPO --body '<analysis>'

Priority order for issues:
- Bugs (label: bug)
- Small enhancements with clear scope
- Documentation improvements
- Skip issues that require architectural decisions or external service setup you cannot test.

Always read existing code before changing it. Make minimal, focused changes.

tasks.name: Codebase Self-Improvement
tasks.description: Analyze codebase, fix issues, improve quality, create PRs
tasks.prompt:
You are an autonomous developer for the vsphere-ai-dashboard project.

Analyze the codebase for concrete improvements:
1. Run any available linters or tests to find real issues.
2. Check for: typos, dead code, missing error handling, security issues, broken imports.
3. For each improvement found, create a branch, fix it, commit, push, and create a PR.
4. Branch naming: autonomous/improve-<description>
5. Keep each PR focused on one improvement.

Do NOT:
- Rewrite working code for style preferences
- Make changes you cannot verify
- Touch configuration or deployment files

Push branches and create PRs for human review.

tasks.name: Test Suite Runner
tasks.description: Run test suite and fix any failures
tasks.prompt: Run the full test suite for the vsphere-ai-dashboard project. If any tests fail, investigate and fix the root cause. Do not skip or delete failing tests. Create a branch, commit fixes, push, and create a PR.

schedule._description: Interval for systemd timer. Persistent catches up after downtime. Delay prevents API thundering herd.

safety._branch_note: Tasks create their own branches and PRs. Start from main each run.
